citation: Ventris, Michael, and John Chadwick. 1956. Documents in Mycenaean Greek: Three Hundred Selected Tablets from Knossos, Pylos, and Mycenae with Commentary and Vocabulary. Cambridge: Cambridge University Press. Pp. xxxii + 452.
notes: Foundational publication documenting the reading of Linear B as Mycenaean Greek (selected tablets from Knossos, Pylos, Mycenae). Bibliographic details confirmed via Classical Review / Journal of Hellenic Studies notices and library catalogs (accessed 2026-10-11). Seed cites only the work’s existence and scope as the standard reference for Linear B = Greek administrative documents — not individual tablet readings or invented page numbers. Later editions (e.g. 1973) exist; this seed registers the 1956 first edition.
